definitions.explanation: A student who transfers into a school from another school, typically mid-year or at the start of a new term.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{転入生|てんにゅうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A transfer student is coming starting today.

examples.japanese: {転入生|てんにゅうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{皆|みんな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}した→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧。
examples.english: The transfer student was introduced in front of everyone.

examples.japanese: {転入生|てんにゅうせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{馴染|なじ}んだ→馴染む：14631_najimu⟧。
examples.english: The transfer student quickly fit in with the class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{転入生|てんにゅうせい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Because of my father's job transfer, I ended up attending a new school as a transfer student.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{転入|てんにゅう}→転入：22235_tennyuu⟧ (transfer in) + {生|せい} (student). A common trope in Japanese anime and manga is the mysterious or exciting {転入生|てんにゅうせい} who disrupts the classroom dynamic. In real life, transfer students are common in Japan due to the frequency of corporate relocations (⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転入生|てんにゅうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: a transfer student arrives
- {転入生|てんにゅうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: welcome a transfer student
- {転入生|てんにゅうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自己紹介|じこしょうかい}→自己紹介：12331_jikoshoukai⟧: transfer student's self-introduction
- ⟦{転入|てんにゅう}→転入：22235_tennyuu⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: transfer enrollment procedures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{転校生|てんこうせい}→転校生：19652_tenkousei⟧: transfer student (more common in everyday speech)
- ⟦{編入生|へんにゅうせい}→編入生：22044_hennyuusei⟧: student admitted mid-course (university level)
- ⟦{留学生|りゅうがくせい}→留学生：02986_ryuugakusei⟧: international/exchange student (different concept)
